30-8.title: Screen a teenager for depression with a proper tool and a trained adult, not a school assembly
30-8.inPlainWords: A school mental-health survey is not a diagnosis. If a teenager has two weeks of low mood, lost interest, sleep or appetite change, or thoughts of self-harm, use a validated questionnaire such as the PHQ-A and have a trained counsellor or doctor interpret it. The District Mental Health Programme and Tele-MANAS on 14416 can help. Do not rely on a single score or a teacher's impression.
30-8.benefit: The National Mental Health Programme and the District Mental Health Programme place mental-health services in district hospitals; school counsellors and the Rashtriya Kishor Swasthya Karyakram adolescent health clinics are the local route. A validated tool is a screening aid, not a diagnosis. The Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 protects the rights of a person with a mental illness and requires informed consent. A school should have a referral protocol, not a public ranking.
30-8.cost: A government consultation is free or low cost. Tele-MANAS on 14416 is free.
30-8.caveats: A screening result should stay confidential. A positive screen needs a clinical assessment, not a label. If there is a risk of suicide, do not leave the teenager alone; call 14416 or 112.
30-8.sources: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, National Mental Health Programme. <https://mohfw.gov.in/>; Tele-MANAS. <https://telemanas.mohfw.gov.in/>; Mental Healthcare Act, 2017. <https://www.indiacode.nic.in/>

30-15.title: If a child says they are attracted to the same sex, listen and protect them — do not send them for 'conversion'
30-15.inPlainWords: In India, consensual same-sex relations between adults are not a crime after the Supreme Court's judgment in Navtej Singh Johar v Union of India (2018). A parent's rejection, a forced 'conversion' or a threat to throw the child out increases the risk of depression and suicide. Listen, keep the child safe, and if you need help, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 or a counsellor who does not promise to change orientation.
30-15.benefit: The Supreme Court read down section 377 of the Indian Penal Code in 2018, so consensual same-sex conduct between adults is not an offence. The Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 prohibits discrimination in mental-health care and requires informed consent. 'Conversion therapy' is not a recognised treatment and is opposed by the Indian Psychiatric Society. A family that rejects a child increases the risk of homelessness and self-harm.
30-15.cost: No cost to listen. A counsellor costs money; Tele-MANAS is free.
30-15.caveats: A minor may still face bullying at school and a hostile relative. Do not out the child to others without consent. If the child is in danger at home, contact Childline on 1098 or the police.
30-15.sources: Supreme Court of India, Navtej Singh Johar v Union of India (2018). <https://www.sci.gov.in/>; Mental Healthcare Act, 2017. <https://www.indiacode.nic.in/>; Tele-MANAS. <https://telemanas.mohfw.gov.in/>; Indian Psychiatric Society. <https://indianpsychiatricsociety.org/>
